items.title: Jules Cahn Interview, 1974-10-06
items.q: The interviewee discusses the influence of Professor Longhair's song 'Going to the Mardi Gras' on New Orleans music generally, but does not mention any personal interaction, meeting, or direct professional relationship with Professor Longhair.

Uh, in 1949, Professor Longhair did a song called Going to the Mardi Gras, and I think, I think this had, had some, something to do with the Indians. Yeah. Or vice versa. Or vice versa.
